SourceDefinition.description: Unified Source connection. Choose the matching protocol object; edge-sql uses one of sql.query (preset) or sql.queries (named). Query the target protocol catalog for installed execution, TLS and state capabilities.

credentialRef.description: Opaque existing credential reference returned for authorized editing and accepted on input. It contains no secret. Provision secrets only through create.credentials or credentials/update; secret material is never returned in the document.

endpoint.description: Protocol connection address or a discovered native device key. Never include credentials in the address. Managed server roles use the target-defined managed endpoint.

tls.description: Target-managed TLS references. Targets without reference resolution must explicitly report unsupported. Prefer protocol caCertificate for public CA material; private keys belong in credentials.values.

ingress.description: Managed MQTT device ingress allocation. Requires mqtt protocol and server role; targets without this capability must reject it as unsupported, never ignore it.

id.description: User-declared logical resource selection name within this Source, not a database Source ID or asset file ID. Reuse the same selection name for stable resource identity.

query.description: Preset approved business SELECT, supported on Cloud and Enterprise. Tool/WMS presets require PostgreSQL; quality-inspections requires SQL Server. Fixed reads support keyset scan; verify-full TLS is required. Query and queries are mutually exclusive.

queries.description: Source-owned named queries on Cloud and Enterprise; never override SQL in Stream acquisition. PostgreSQL/MySQL use read-only transactions and bounded read. SQL Server has no public preview or live-query dryRun; explicitly authorized Stream execution is potentially writing and uses effect journaling. No named-query scan. limit 1..100; timeoutMs 100..10000.
